title: ناخن شماره ۷: ماموریت زنده‌ موندن
format: Movie-trailer parody. Cinematic letterbox bars, film grain, dramatic title cards, slow-mo hits, camera shakes, orchestral-style sting feel. Cute (never scary): villains are everyday objects with cartoon faces.
goal: Share-worthy, high-motion reel. 28-36 s total. Strong 1-second cinematic hook, escalating gags, payoff, loop with the 'nail #8' tease.

cast.name: Number 7
cast.desc: tiny pink almond-nail-shaped blob, huge eyes, small bandage on its head, brave but terrified

cast.name: Gel
cast.desc: glossy translucent-blue blob knight, helmet shaped like a gel drop, brush sword, calm and heroic

cast.name: Villains
cast.desc: car door, soda can, loose sweater thread: cute-menacing cartoon faces, never gory

scenes.idea: Epic cinematic opener: black screen, dust and light shafts, slow push-in on a tiny pink nail-shaped blob (Number 7) with a small bandage on its head standing alone on a giant fingertip landscape like a canyon. Low brass sting, title letterbox bars slide in.

Giant car door looms with a menacing cartoon grin, slamming in slow motion toward Number 7; time freeze, camera whip-zoom, Number 7 dives out of the way, door slams with a shockwave and cracks the ground.
Soda can villain with a sly face and a pull-tab smirk, fizz fog, tab clicks like a switchblade; Number 7 sneaks past in stealth-movie style with a spotlight sweep.

scenes.text: و یه تار پشمی... که هیچ‌کس ازش جون سالم به در نبرد
scenes.idea: Camera low-angle: a loose sweater thread whips like a lasso and snags Number 7; dramatic freeze, 'wanted' poster style card pops with the thread's cute-menacing face; Number 7 gulps, sweat drop.

scenes.text: تا اینکه یه قهرمان از راه رسید
scenes.idea: Smash cut to bright light: Gel, a glossy translucent-blue blob knight with a gel-drop helmet and brush sword, descends in slow motion with a lens flare and cape of sparkles; Number 7 looks up with heart eyes; epic orchestral swell.

scenes.text: سه لایه، یه لامپ، یه معجزه
scenes.idea: Fast action montage: base coat, color coat, top coat slashed on like sword moves with speed lines; a UV lamp glows and a power-up ring pulses; Number 7 becomes glossy, armored and sparkling; hard cuts on the beat.
Slow-motion hero pose: car door, can and thread villains bounce harmlessly off glossy Number 7 in a cartoon fight; Number 7 flicks the bandage off; sunset rim light, golden dust.

scenes.text: تگ کن اونی رو که ناخناش همیشه می‌شکنه
scenes.idea: Number 7 and Gel face the viewer and point at the camera together; a tiny 'coming soon' stinger: a small blob nail #8 peeks in with a bandage, setting up the loop back to the opening; end-card @ayda.nailroom.
